account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Your Quark profile and platform connections
account.emailVerifyHint: Verify your email to add Quark friends.
account.tipProfile: Edit your avatar, bio and card colors — that’s how friends see you.
account.tipSteam: Link Steam to sync your library and achievements.
account.tipFriends: Share your friend code to add someone on Quark Chat.

home.noCategoriesHint: Create categories to group games on the home page — like playlists.
home.dragHint: Drag cards or sections to reorder

profile.editProfileDesc: Avatar, pronouns, status and profile card appearance.
profile.avatarHint: Upload a custom avatar shown in the menu and on your profile card.
profile.avatarFormats: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF · max 5 MB
profile.basicHint: Name and bio visible to friends.
profile.appearanceHint: Colors and effects for your profile card.
profile.previewHint: Hover to see the 3D tilt effect
profile.pronounsHint: Optional — shown on your profile card

steam.title: Steam integration
steam.idleDesc: Sign in with Steam — no need to paste profile URLs manually.
steam.connectedDesc: Steam account linked via Quark server.
steam.loginHint: Steam will open in your browser. Return to the launcher after signing in.
steam.inputRequired: Enter Steam ID or profile URL

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.openFriendsHint: Open the friends panel to accept

launcher.steamDialogDesc: Link your Steam account to sync friends, achievements and stats.
launcher.apiUnavailable: Cannot reach Quark server. Some features may be unavailable.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, language and app preferences
settings.themeOledHint: OLED mode uses pure black to save power on OLED displays
settings.steamHint: Required to display player achievements and stats
settings.steamAccountHint: Connect Steam from the Account tab or profile menu — use “Sign in with Steam”. No API key required.
settings.devPanelDesc: Unlock by searching “dev:5827” and pressing Ctrl+Shift+N (when the game list is empty).
settings.devToolsHint: Opens Chromium DevTools for UI debugging (Electron only).
settings.devInspectorHint: Separate window with tabs: env, settings, storage, registries, events, banner tests.
settings.showI18nKeysDesc: Shows message key paths instead of translations (e.g. nav.stats_m instead of “Statistics”).
settings.privacyDesc: Data helps us improve Quark during the beta. You can turn collection off anytime.
settings.analyticsEnabledDesc: Sessions, navigation, game launches — no personal content
settings.diagnosticsEnabledDesc: API errors and crashes with sanitized context
settings.privacyBetaNote: Beta: analytics on by default (opt-out). We never collect passwords, tokens, or message content.
settings.notifyFriendPlayingDesc: Notify when a Quark friend starts playing a game
settings.overlayDesc: HUD panel during a game session launched from Quark. Logo on the left, performance on the right.
settings.overlayFpsNote: FPS reflects overlay window refresh (estimate), not in-game frames. GPU needs NVIDIA (nvidia-smi) or Windows performance counters.

overlay.showLogoDesc: Quark title in the top-left corner
overlay.showCpuChartDesc: Mini chart of CPU load history
overlay.showChatNotificationsDesc: Overlay toast when a message arrives during a game
overlay.chatNotificationsWhenHiddenDesc: System notification when the overlay is hidden

chat.title: Chat
chat.selectHint: Message a friend from the friends panel or create a group.
chat.groupHint: Name visible to all group members.
chat.dmRenameHint: Custom label for this chat (instead of the friend’s nick).
chat.noFriendsToAdd: All friends are already in this group

stats.comingSoonHint: Quark Recap (top games, genres, streak) lands in the next release.
